translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: MATAIO
book.title: Mataio Yeng Yesuac Siduc Gombung Ohoec

content: Yesungo tikiunac mamanu habutoa kuneng yombongngo ye modacgec.
Modacmagec ngic mong kukuseriagocngo hama fafoc heimima deec, “Kebu, ge negenna naric anu medzuacnubang.”
Ifi deu Yesungo maria sinema ngic kpeserema yofi edeec, “Ge ngereenadeac songona fede.” Deu imohaingoc sebia ngereeu hafeia kpac anec.

Nga Yesungo yofi edema deraheec, “Ge sebigau faka fingecdac, imocac ngic mong mi edebesena. Ge womong gareng yearu kemma sebiga edzahena. Edzahema Mosengo seseac deec, imoc modacma imocac sirihau faina yeneng sesega imoc hemma negentegecgecde.”
Anu Yesungo Kafanaung taonnu emmanu wasaigareng mongngo hama meficgeudeac desambic amma deec,
“Kunenna, enac tofoc tofoho medacna ye hanimaria homemea amma ye amau kpendzengtoa kpema fema kecde.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi edeec, “Ni naric hama mengerebade.”
Ifi deu wasai garengngo yoac yofi meremmiec, “Kunenna, ni noc gombunnaac amawarocnau erenade. Ge yoacgangosac dena enac tofoc tofoho medacna ngereeude.

Imoc yofi, ni ngic kucnginagoc yeneac bageu kecduae. Nga neac bageu wasaifocna kecdae. Yenearunac monggac kenna deba ye kenude. Ni yenearunac monggac hana deba haude. Nga wanacngicnaac ua yomoc mena deba ye imoc meude.”
Ifi deu Yesungo imoc negemma kerectegec amma ngicngac modacgec, yeni yofi edeyunuec, “Foracngoc, Israe bangecfu ngicngac negen negensingngina seria yofia mong mi henai, imoc yeac henduae.
Imocac yofi edengunuduae, ngic homacngo wenac ere ereaunac nga wenac keme kemeaunac hama Abrahang nga Isaka amma Yakobo yenigoc kurumenggac eucererennu yenahafoc tacma neneyaka negecde.
Nga Anutungo warac warac yengena eucererenggac areng deec, yeni ine ngadeau kundunnu ukuyunugec kemegecde. Kemema ihai kiacma enacngina kisaranggema kecgecde.”
Ifi dema wasaigareng yofi edeec, “Ge kenna, negensinggenecmoc, imoc fora fingecgenude.” Anu wenac naso imohaingoc enac tofoc tofoho medaha ngereec.
Anu Yesungo Petoroac amau emma Petoro sefenango sebigerec ammiu feu henec.
Hemma mariau mema kpesereu sefena hafeia kpac anu yacma yenenggareng ayemmeec.
Marai anu imohaingoc ngicngac yeneng ngicngac hadehade nga yafinggoc homac Yesuaru meyunuu hagec. Hagec, yeng yoac dema asu mangana kporacyunuma hafeinginagoc sasawa mengereyunuec.
Profete Yesaiango warac yofi deec, “Yeng nenang kucmamanina meickema hafeinina atickeec.” (Yesaia 53:4) imoc imohai fora fingerec.
Ngicngac habutoango Yesu oronggegec ye ifi yenemma medacfora edeyunuec, “Nenang dzohong noboc kenni.”
Ifi demanu mitiac negen negengngic mongngo hama edeec, “Kpoukpou, ge ihai me ihai kennadesoc ni modacguma gegoc kembadeac negenduae.”
Ifi deu Yesungo yofi deec, “Katekasi yeni bangec manau fefenginagoc nga sawau neng yeni faecnginagoc nga ngicac Medacngo ine kparicganga kpac, ifi kecde.”
Deu medacfora yenearunac mongngo deec, “Kebu, negennemmana kemma manna tonggomaguc modacgubade.”
Ifi deu Yesungo ine yofi edeec, “Ge homemea wayununa yeni yenaocngoc tonggoemegec. Nga geng ine ni modacnuna.”
Yesungo gombau enu medacfora yenahafoc gombau emma kenggec.
Kemmagec firang kucgoc kpeu siritembongngo gomba feraheu kemebesonga anec nga Yesungo ine gau feec.
Feu medac yeneng Yesuaru kemma midima degec, “Kebu ge onggonnununa, neni kemebeso andimbe.”
Ifi degec yeng yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni negen negensingngina kapianecsac fede, ngeni kengec mi ambisia.” Ifi dema firang nga dzohong kpetariyemeru firang kpac anu dzohong ye ning kpema eng feec.
Feu ngic yeni kerectegec amma kpesiemegec, “Ye noc ngic? Firang nga dzohongtoa yereng yeac enara tofohodape.”
Anu yeni dzohong noboc gadarangic, yeneac bangecfu kensikemagec ngic yohockang hadehadengiragocngo kicsereunac haoc. Yeri wasai yombong, imocac ngicngac yeni imohacsing susuferecge mi angkecgec.
Nga yeri ihai namma kpacma deoc, “Anutuac Medac, neneac wiac imoc geac mi ande. Nasonina mi hamanu ge kpendzeng monnu mi fainunubesena.”
Anu edibigeng berechabu mong kuneng yeni surukpema kecmagec
hadehade yeneng yofi dema Yesu desambic ammigec, “Ge kporacnununade isoc, berechabu yenearu suenununa kemebisina.”
Ifi degec yeng yofi edeyunuec, “Ngeni meickegec.” Deu yeni meickema erema berechabu yenearu kemegec berec yeni hafoangoc fagannunac nedzima dzohonnu kemema doku nema homedacgec.
Homegec berecgareng yeneng kengec worama taonnu kemma faka imocac siduc sasawa ayemmegec. Ayemmedacma ngic hadehadengiragoc yerearu faka fingerec, imocac ifingoc edeyunugec.
Edeyunugec taong imocac ngicngac sasawango Yesu meficgegecdeac kemma hemma amabangecngina waudeac edegec.

footnotes.text: Mongngo kukuserigoc sebia wonongagoc dekecgec. Ngic homacngo hafei ifia mi megecdeac kukuseriagoc yeni ama ngadeau kecbisia. Imoc Moseac dedeseriyoacfu oho ohoya feec.
Wasaigareng yomoc yeac bageau wasaingic 100 isoc kecgec. Wasaingic garengnginagoc yeni bangec monnunac.
